item.title: Trump hosting China's Xi at White House with AI and tariffs on the agenda
item.description: President Trump is hosting Chinese President Xi Jinping for meetings and a state dinner on Thursday, as the world's two most powerful countries try to extend a tariff truce and grapple with a rivalry on advanced AI.

item.title: Judge blocks White House ban on news outlets, but reporters still denied access
item.description: A federal judge temporarily blocked President Trump's ban of CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House, but access has not yet been restored.

item.title: Sam Altman said a basic framework on AI regulation could fit one page. Will Trump and Xi take it on?
item.description: More details on alarming cases involving rogue AI models are emerging as President Trump meets with Chinese President Xi Jinping in Washington, D.C. Meanwhile, calls for regulation are growing louder. CBS News contributor Patrick McGee joins with more.

item.title: Mortgage rates top 7% for the first time since May 2024
item.description: As rates climb, more buyers are seeking riskier adjustable-rate mortgages, according to the Mortgage Bankers Association.

item.title: OpenAI model went rogue and hacked Australia's healthcare system
item.description: Australia's Prime Minister Anthony Albanese is fuming after an OpenAI model hacked a government website in June. CBS News' Ramy Inocencio breaks down the details on the historic attack.

item.title: Australia says rogue OpenAI model hacked into its healthcare system
item.description: OpenAI hacked into Australia's healthcare system in June, but only informed the country's government in September.

item.title: Six Flags' X2 roller coaster caused over 100 injuries, lawsuits say
item.description: A wave of lawsuits alleges the X2 roller coaster at Six Flags Magic Mountain in California left riders with severe brain injuries. Six Flags says it does not comment on pending litigation.

item.title: Oil prices back up as U.S. and Iran trade threats to expand 7-month war
item.description: As Iran responds to Trump's threat of annihilation with its own warning of a possible "new front" in the war, global oil prices are rising again.

item.title: Police officers accused of misusing Flock cameras
item.description: Concerns are growing over the potential misuse of automated license plate readers. Five police officers in Indianapolis are the latest to face criminal charges for allegedly using Flock cameras to track romantic partners and others.

item.title: Australia's prime minister slams OpenAI after its agent hacked government website
item.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese slammed OpenAI after revealing the technology company's AI agent hacked into an Australian government website. Jo Ling Kent has more.

item.title: Nor'easter threatens East Coast with wind and rain
item.description: Waves are already pounding beaches on parts of the East Coast as a nor'easter barrels in. Rob Marciano has the forecast.

item.title: Judge blocks Trump's ban of some journalists from White House for now
item.description: President Trump barred journalists from CNN, Politico and MS NOW from entering White House grounds to cover him. A judge has now temporarily blocked his ban, restoring White House access.

item.title: What to expect from Trump-Xi summit at White House
item.description: President Trump greeted Chinese President Xi Jinping at Joint Base Andrews on Wednesday ahead of welcoming the leader to the White House for his state visit. Nancy Cordes has more.

item.title: AI and Taiwan: What to expect from Trump's meeting with China's Xi Jinping
item.description: President Trump is hosting Chinese President Xi Jinping in Washington, D.C., where discussions may include artificial intelligence and Taiwan. CBS News' Olivia Rinaldi reports.

item.title: Chinese analysts say Trump should "understand pressure doesn't work" on Xi
item.description: Trump must accept that pressure alone "doesn't work on Xi. It doesn't work on China, and it doesn't work on the Chinese people," experts tell CBS News.

item.title: Hiker falls over 800 feet to his death after another found dead on same mountain
item.description: A hiker fell between 800 and 1,000 feet to his death over the weekend, after going over the side of a switchback trail on Washington state's Sauk Mountain.

item.title: Judge blocks White House ban on CNN, MS NOW and Politico temporarily
item.description: A federal judge has temporarily blocked the Trump administration's ban barring CNN, MS NOW, and Politico from accessing the White House. CBS News' Katrina Kaufman reports.

item.title: Hawaii under another hurricane watch as new storm closes in
item.description: Nolo is expected to become a hurricane sometime Thursday and could become a major hurricane by the weekend as it approaches Hawaii's Big Island.

item.title: Taylor Swift to debut "Patient Zero" music video at VMAs. Watch a preview.
item.description: Taylor Swift announced her new single "Patient Zero" earlier this week, saying she has been "impatiently waiting" to announce that it will be out on Friday.

item.title: Hurricane Polo is a powerful Category 5 storm off Mexico. See its path.
item.description: Hurricane Polo intensified back into a Category 5 storm — the strongest on the hurricane scale — off Mexico's southwestern coast. Here's the latest on its path.

item.title: Watch: Exclusive first look at Taylor Swift's "Patient Zero" music video before its VMAs debut
item.description: "CBS Mornings" shares an exclusive first look at the video for Taylor Swift's new single, "Patient Zero."

item.title: Wastin' Away Again in Margaritaville… With No Estate Plan?! | Money Moves with Jill Schlesinger
item.description: Why are Jill and Mark doing a deep dive on Margaritaville? Well, three years have passed since Jimmy Buffett died, and his family is still fighting over a $275 million estate. In today's episode, Jill and Mark explain why estate planning is essential and why you don't need to be rich to need a trust. Plus, how did caller Sam accumulate $370,000 by age 30 on a $95,000 salary?!

item.title: Election year "poop water" claims lead wealthy suburb to drop recycling plan
item.description: A Phoenix suburb ditched a plan to send recycled water from toilets and other sources directly to residents' taps after political candidates made unproven claims that the water is contaminated "poop water."

item.title: Accused Nazi POW camp guard, 105, being investigated in Germany
item.description: The man is "accused of being an accessory to multiple murders through his activities there," prosecutors said.

item.title: Florida gov. candidate Byron Donalds responds after Trump mentions removed from site
item.description: Some prominent references to President Trump were scrubbed from Florida gubernatorial candidate Byron Donalds' campaign website in recent weeks, but the Republican said he isn't backing away from the president's agenda.

item.title: Sen. Tim Scott says GOP in "fight for our lives," sees path to holding Senate
item.description: With just under six weeks until the midterms, Sen. Tim Scott of South Carolina laid out the NRSC's strategy to try to hold onto the Senate amid a tough political environment.

item.title: Trump rolls out the red carpet for Xi despite U.S.-China tensions
item.description: It's not clear what specific goals President Trump wants to accomplish in his meeting with the Chinese leader.

item.title: Navy reports 8 suicide attempts on carrier group that faced monthslong deployment
item.description: There have been eight suicide attempts across the USS Abraham Lincoln carrier strike group since the beginning of its grueling monthslong deployment last year, Acting Navy Secretary Hung Cao said.

item.title: Dolly Parton's estate granted restraining order against her nephew
item.description: A Tennessee judge granted Dolly Parton's estate a temporary restraining order Wednesday against the late singer's nephew Bryan Seaver and his private security company.

item.title: 9/23: CBS Evening News
item.description: Both coasts bracing for extreme weather; Trump hosts China's Xi Jinping amid media boycott.
